description: Courier booking system — scopes + role templates per docs/10-Courier-Security.md §1.2. Plant (werks) is a STATIC attribute value set per role instance in the cockpit (~17 per-region collections, pattern Courier_<Role>_<Region>). SuperUser has NO app scopes by design (SoD) — role assignment happens in the cockpit only.

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.reprint
scopes.description: Reprint / download stored labels (labels are PII)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.config
scopes.description: Maintain non-secret carrier/printer/route config (audited; secrets live in the destination service only)

attributes.name: werks
attributes.description: Plant(s) this role grants access to — STATIC value per role instance, never from the IdP. courier-srv filters every parcel-data route by it.

role-templates.name: CourierDispatcher
role-templates.description: Worklist, rate, book, print, reprint — own plant

role-templates.name: CourierSupervisor
role-templates.description: Dispatcher + void + carrier override — own plant

role-templates.name: CourierSupport
role-templates.description: View + reprint only. Cannot book. Own plant(s)

role-templates.name: CourierSysAdmin
role-templates.description: Carrier/printer/route config — own region. No role administration (SoD)
